mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(ifnull(wid.mete, 0)), 0) mete, ifnull(sum(ifnull(wid.quantity, 0)), 0) quantity, ifnull(sum(ifnull(wid.input_VAT, 0)), 0) inputVAT, ifnull(sum(ifnull(wid.amount, 0)), 0) amount, ifnull(sum(ifnull(wid.amount_excluding_VAT, 0)), 0) amountExcludingVAT, (select price_excluding_VAT from wms_inbound_detail order by create_time desc LIMIT 1) unitPriceExcludingVAT from wms_inbound_detail wid left join wms_inbound wi on wi.id = wid.inbound_id where wid.weighted_average_price_id = #{wapId} and wi.review_status = 2 and wid.bool_delete_enum = 0

SELECT wid.*, wi.*, wi.id inboundId from wms_inbound wi RIGHT JOIN wms_inbound_detail wid on wid.inbound_id = wi.id where wi.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wid.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wi.purchase_id = #{purchaseOrderId}

SELECT ifnull(sum(wid.amount), 0) amount, ifnull(sum(wid.amount_excluding_VAT), 0) amountExcludingVat from wms_inbound wi RIGHT JOIN wms_inbound_detail wid on wid.inbound_id = wi.id where wi.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wid.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wi.purchase_id = #{purchaseOrderId} and wi.review_status = 2

select wid.*, p.id pid, p.short_name psName, p.serial_number pSN, p.name pn, pm.name pmName, pa.name paName, mbf.id mbfId, mbf.name mbfName, wm.measure_unit wmu, wm.measure_precision wmp, wm.accounting_unit wau, wm.accounting_precision wap, ww.id wwId, ww.name wwName from wms_inbound_detail wid left join contract_project p on p.id = wid.project_id left join wms_workshop mbf on wid.workshop_id = mbf.id left join wms_warehouse ww on ww.id = wid.warehouse_id left join wms_measure wm on wm.classification_id = wid.classify_id left join plan_monomer pm on pm.id = wid.monomer_id left join plan_area pa on pa.id = wid.area_id where wid.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wid.inbound_id = #{id}

select DATE_FORMAT(wi.review_time,'%m') date, ifnull(sum(wid.mete),0) mete, ifnull(sum(wid.amount),0) amount from wms_inbound_detail wid left join wms_inbound wi on wid.inbound_id = wi.id where wid.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wi.review_status = 2 and wid.basic_class = #{basicClass} and wid.bool_party_a = 0
and DATE_FORMAT(wi.review_time,'%y') = DATE_FORMAT(#{year},'%y')
and wid.classify_id = #{classifyId}
and wid.theory_thickness = #{thickness}
and find_in_set(#{specId},specification_ids)
and find_in_set(#{sectionSteelSpecId},section_steel_spec_ids)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(review_time,'%m')

select wid.theory_thickness thickness, wid.specification spec, ifnull(sum(wid.mete), 0) mete from wms_inbound_detail wid left join wms_inbound wi on wid.inbound_id = wi.id where wid.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wi.review_status = 2 and wid.basic_class = #{basicClass} and wid.bool_party_a = 0 and DATE_FORMAT(wi.review_time, '%y') = DATE_FORMAT(#{year}, '%y') GROUP BY theory_thickness, specification

select wid.classify_name classifyName, wsd.value spec, ifnull(sum(wid.mete), 0) mete from wms_inbound_detail wid left join wms_inbound wi on wid.inbound_id = wi.id left join wms_specification_details wsd on wid.specification_ids = wsd.id where wid.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wi.review_status = 2 and wid.basic_class = #{basicClass} and wid.bool_party_a = 0 and DATE_FORMAT(wi.review_time, '%y') = DATE_FORMAT(#{year}, '%y') GROUP BY classify_name, specification_ids

select theory_thickness from wms_inbound_detail wid left join wms_inbound wi on wid.inbound_id = wi.id where wid.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wi.review_status = 2 and wid.classify_id = #{classifyId} GROUP BY theory_thickness order by theory_thickness

select count(case when quality_testing_enum = 1 THEN 1 end) '待质检', count(case when quality_testing_enum = 16 THEN 1 end) '无质检' from wms_inbound_detail where bool_delete_enum = 0 and inbound_id = #{id}

select ifnull(sum(wid.mete), 0) FROM wms_inbound_detail wid LEFT JOIN wms_inbound wi ON wi.id = wid.inbound_id where wid.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wi.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wi.review_status = 2 and wid.basic_class & #{basicClass} > 0 and DATE_FORMAT(wi.review_time , '%Y%m') = #{year}

select wid.* FROM wms_inbound_detail wid LEFT JOIN wms_inbound wi ON wi.id = wid.inbound_id where wid.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wi.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wi.review_status = 2 and wid.basic_class & #{basicClass} > 0 and wid.project_id = #{pid} and DATE_FORMAT(wi.review_time , '%Y') = #{year}

select wid.* FROM wms_inbound_detail wid LEFT JOIN wms_inbound wi ON wi.id = wid.inbound_id where wid.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wi.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wi.review_status = 2 and (wid.apply_purchase_id = #{id} or (wid.apply_purchase_id is null and exists ( select 1 from scm_purchase_order_detail pod where pod.id=wid.purchase_order_detail_id and pod.bool_delete_enum=0 and pod.apply_purchase_id=#{id} ))) order by wid.basic_class, wid.thickness

select DATE_FORMAT(wid.create_time, "%Y-%m") as dateTime, IFNULL( SUM( wid.mete ), 0 ) totalMete, IFNULL( SUM( wid.amount_excluding_vat ), 0 ) totalCost from wms_statistics_inbound wid where wid.bool_delete_enum = 0
and wid.basic_class & #{basicClass} > 0
and wid.classify_id in
#{item}
AND DATE_FORMAT(wid.create_time, "%Y") = DATE_FORMAT(#{yearDate}, "%Y")
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_branch_company_link pbcl WHERE pbcl.bool_delete_enum=0 AND pbcl.branch_company_level=2 AND pbcl.branch_company_id=#{branchCompanyId} AND pbcl.project_id=wid.project_id)
AND wid.workshop_id=#{workshopId}
group by DATE_FORMAT(wid.create_time, "%Y-%m")

select wid.* from wms_inbound_detail wid left join wms_inbound wi on wid.inbound_id = wi.id where wid.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wi.review_status = 2
and wid.basic_class & #{basicClass} > 0
and wid.classify_id in
#{item}
AND DATE_FORMAT(wid.create_time, "%Y-%m") = DATE_FORMAT(#{mouthDate}, "%Y-%m")
AND EXISTS( select 1 from project_branch_company_link pbcl where pbcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pbcl.branch_company_level = 2 and pbcl.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId} and pbcl.project_id = wid.project_id )
AND wid.workshop_id = #{workshopId}

SELECT sum( wid.mete ) FROM wms_inbound wi LEFT JOIN wms_inbound_detail wid ON wi.id = wid.inbound_id WHERE wi.review_status = 2 AND wid.basic_class IN ( 1, 2, 4 ) AND wid.create_time >= DATE_FORMAT( CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01' ) AND wid.create_time < DATE_FORMAT( CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01' );

SELECT wid.* FROM wms_inbound_detail wid LEFT JOIN wms_inbound wi ON wid.inbound_id = wi.id and wi.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE wid.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wi.review_status = 2 AND wid.purchase_order_detail_id IN
#{item}

select wi.purchase_id as id, IFNULL(sum(wid.mete),0) as mete from wms_inbound_detail wid left join wms_inbound wi on wid.inbound_id = wi.id where wid.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wi.review_status = 2
and wi.purchase_id in
#{purchaseId}
group by wi.purchase_id
